run_test_cross_entropy: run the test_cross_entropy function to validate model parallel cross entropy against standard PyTorch cross entropy
run_torch_cross_entropy: run the torch_cross_entropy function to compute standard PyTorch cross entropy loss and gradients for given batch parameters
run_mpu_cross_entropy: run the mpu_cross_entropy function to compute model parallel cross entropy loss using vocab parallel cross entropy
test_vocab_parallel_cross_entropy: test the vocab_parallel_cross_entropy function by comparing its output and gradients against standard PyTorch cross entropy
run_main_test_loop: run the main test loop that iterates model parallel sizes and validates cross entropy correctness at each size
